# GTK Thunderbird packaging lists gfxtest instead of glxtest and vaapitest

The package manifest lists gfxtest and mozgtk only inside MOZ_GTK. The nested MOZ_WAYLAND branch keeps mozwayland and no longer lists vaapitest. The Thunderbird installer Makefile selects this manifest. This records package inputs; it does not prove that an upstream helper was built, launched or ABI-compatible.

Scope: Thunderbird GTK graphics-helper packaging.
